what: On first open, four dots in the center of the background-color curtain light up and go out in turn, one beat (.5s) each, repeating. Once the fonts (up to 3 seconds) and images have all arrived and .25s has passed after they settle, the curtain fades out straight over .5s and lifts — the dots hide immediately as it lifts. There is no transition on leaving.

options.min: Minimum seconds to wait after pinning, default .25 — 0 means as soon as it is ready
options.fonts: Max seconds to wait for the font, default 3
options.cycle: Length of one dot revolution (seconds), default .5 — dot k lights at 12.5% x (k+1) of the revolution and stays on for half a turn
options.look: If ”box”, it covers the nearest positioned parent instead of the screen (position: absolute)
options.--fx-size · --fx-gap: Dot diameter and gap (via style), default 8px · 12px
options.--fx-c1 · --fx-c2: Odd dot and even dot colors (via style), default --kf-accent · --kf-accent-text
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: Dots (children, usually four). If absent, only the curtain lifts away
options.fx:done: When the curtain has fully lifted, the element fires this event

use: — Place it in the HTML as the first child of body (it must cover from the very first frame so the content doesn’t show through)
note: The original waits for the font kit’s wf-active flag and imagesLoaded — the part catches the same moments with document.fonts.ready and window load

from.where: shared.css .hd-mask (all pages — original .transitionmask: four yellow·sky dots on a white curtain, opacity .5s linear on siteReady)

shared.css .tn-mask (all pages — the same production company’s .transitionmask: white mask with three ink dots inside [ ] brackets, vanishes with height 0 + visibility hidden and no transition once the font, first image, first video frame and 1 second are all done)
from.options: fade: 0; min: 1 · three dots · style: --fx-size: .4rem; --fx-gap: .3rem; --fx-c1: var(--kf-ink); --fx-c2: var(--kf-ink)
